Spaces groundwork: a Zone-stamped Group inside a Zone is a nested container ignored by the Face table, Suggest, Classify picks, Solve and export; removing the stamp restores the Face

Spaces records and operations: panel-closed walkthrough, one native Undo and Redo per write, native copy, cut and Make Unique of a Space Group, airflow states and user_data through save and reopen, two Models isolated

Spaces edit contexts: Volume protection on exit by any callback order, direct Volume switch, a save or autosave from an open Volume leaves the user in it and a Volume saved unlocked is protected on open (D3a-19), Restore position, drawing at the Space root, Undo/Redo, two Models isolated

Spaces copies and moves: a Space copy and an array made independent in the copy's Undo step with the next numbers, cut and paste left alone, Volume and Floor Segment copies found and made independent, a Space in a component found with no repair, Move Space to Zone under a rotated wrapper, a Zone copy with its Spaces, Restore Zone around a Space, save and reopen

Colour-by derived geometry and readouts: a synthetic mode with derived geometry and a readout draw with no change to callers, depth, tag and hidden-ancestor behavior, legend counts, draw cost at the overlay spike's size, Window Type operation marks

Zone views: the Zones tab with the Faces and Spaces views and a synthetic Zone-only view; switching keeps the filter, expanded and checked Zones and Locate and sends no action; Classify paint stops on a switch; the active view returns after reopening the panel and the Model

The Spaces view: Zone, Space, Volume and Segment rows; in-place edit with stale refusal; range fill and paste as one Undo step; airflow cell states; Zone sums, imbalance marker and inheriting dash; selection bar and Select by; Locate and context entry; findings with repairs

Mark floor and Create Space: Mark floor from the Weighting factor column menu at 1, 0 and a typed factor by click and held drag, the Create Space offer, refusals on the status bar, Escape, deactivation and the pressed glyph, one Undo step per gesture; Create Space from the context menu with its preview; Classify and Mark floor leave one tool

Spaces Colour-by modes: Space, Ventilation, Weighting factor and Height colour Floor Segments and prisms, stable Space colours across reopen, the projected prism base, labels and selection totals in SI and IP with no mode active, nothing added to the SKP

Spaces export: the packaged RBZ exports the reference model; the HBJSON reloads with each Space on its Zone's Room, metrics equal to the panel, airflows as m3/s, user_data on the three honeybee-ph objects; the off-to-the-side line and per-Zone schedule in the report; a copied Zone's Spaces reload on the copied Room

Height from solid: the wedge's volume over net floor area, both numbers reported, one native Undo step, refusals for an open solid, a Group of Groups, a Volume or Space as the solid and a wrong selection
Incident: an unexpected action failure shows Get help, its reference matches the log record, frames are extension-relative, no message text
Page faults: a render failure, an uncaught error and a rejected promise each reach the log; other sections and the footer link keep working
Runtime deadlines: a runtime that never readies and one that goes silent end the export with their codes, Cancel usable, resources released (lifecycle and API assertions; bridge control suffices)
Lost reply: Check status answers a committed change once with no second Undo step; a request never received answers not received
Preferences: a refused write is shown as not saved; Reset display preferences survives restart and leaves other stores
Help & Diagnostics window: opens from the menu with a document open and the panel closed (SketchUp disables extension menus with no document), message-box fallback, degraded log shown
Support report: preview, clipboard and saved file byte-equal; Save sheet cancel writes nothing; Clear history keeps a saved report
Failure views and keyboard: messages say what changed and the next step; keyboard route and 360x520 window; Reopen panel explains loss
Help: offline help opens, Online help and Report a problem open their addresses after the public warning
Bounded wait: a named condition observes timer-driven host work through separate polls, targets the original session and mutates nothing
Wait endings: timeout, invalid condition, Model switch and session disposal end distinctly with the last observed state
Diagnostic read: session and severity filters, a continued cursor, a restarted process named, health and build, a refused filter, wait enrichment, nothing written
Fault controls: loading arms nothing, failed_write and lost_reply arm, intercept and restore with read-back, a dirty baseline is refused
Integrated fault case: a silent runtime ends an export; the wait, the log record and the acceptance receipt name the same run; restore read back and a fresh normal build

SH-03-A8, panel and dialogs under their Content-Security-Policy: the panel renders a snapshot, applies one action and shows a blocked-run report; Agent Access issues and revokes a token; Help & Diagnostics previews a report; no panel_csp_violation
SH-03-A8, an HBJSON export completes through the runtime page under its Content-Security-Policy

Thermal-bridge edge host facts: a tagged edge inside a Zone-like Group under native Divide, native Weld, a push-pull that deletes it, intersect_with across it, and the heal when a crossing edge is erased, each with Undo, Redo, save and fresh-process reopen

Thermal Bridge Type catalog with the panel closed: the walkthrough creates three types, edits, duplicates and deletes one through registered actions; native Undo and Redo of each step; save, fresh-process reopen and the same catalog read back through types.all

Edge assignment with the panel closed on the two-Zone reference model: native selection of roof perimeter Edges inside a Zone, edges.selection, assign, native Undo and Redo, the same inside a Zone under a rotated wrapper; the refusals for an Edge inside a placed Window unit and at the Model root; types.delete with a replacement and Undo; a native split of an assigned Edge read on both pieces; save and fresh-process reopen

The thermal-bridge schedule with the panel closed on the classified reference model: the five reference runs assigned through edges.assign and schedule.all compared with the hand calculation; the same read inside an open context; the counted-twice case and its Undo; an assignment copied to the Model root read as outside a Zone; runs.locate into a Zone under a turned wrapper; the 50,000 Edge measurement
